 Ms. Divya Gulati, Adv.

 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R

The petitioner is an accused for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 471,
120-B of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 24 of Emigration Act, 1983 registered at Police Station HTM Hisar, District Hisar, Haryana.
Under the facts and circumstances of the case, we see absolutely no reason to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
